shared_elements: possible faint traces of incised markings
justification: A shows a boulder densely covered with rows of framed glyph-like blocks arranged in horizontal registers, a clearly deliberate inscribed program; B shows a rock face with a vertical cut column and natural fissures, with at most vague traces of working and no identifiable depicted motifs. The only correspondence is that both are worked/marked stone surfaces, which is generic; the ordered register of cartouche-like signs in A has no counterpart in B.
